meta.note: One source for iOS, macOS and the Mac window's web dashboard. Edit a value here and every platform follows.

color.note: Pure neutral greys (red, green and blue equal): a black sidebar, a near-black page and white text in dark, a near-white page and near-black text in light; cards are outlined, on the page's own colour; the accent is ink, the text colour. Hue is left to the signals, Storage's ranks and a map's water and parks. A value may be another token, `{text}`, or another token at an alpha, `{text} / 6%`. `dark-hc` and `light-hc` (Increase Contrast) are given only where they differ; without one a token takes its appearance's value.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The ground of every screen and window: the iPhone background, the Mac window behind panels. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The Mac window's sidebar, which the page draws: a breath below canvas, so the content column reads as the lit part.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, grouped list sections, the Mac inspector and popover body. The page's own colour: a card shows by its `border`, not by a step up from canvas.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Controls and wells that sit ON a surface: secondary buttons, icon tiles, the selected sidebar row on Mac.

tokens.name: alert-ground
tokens.usage: The ground of a status strip (the home banner, a stream that needs you): one step off canvas, with `hairline`, so a status reads as a thing without a hue. Colour lives on its mark alone.

tokens.name: action-done
tokens.usage: The action control's done face: the capsule pressed in, a breath of tint on its ground with its `hairline` edge, below `raised` so it never reads as an idle secondary. The onboarding's night sets it to `ob-raised`.

tokens.name: bubble-own
tokens.usage: The person's own message in a conversation: a step past raised (lighter in dark, darker in light), so theirs and yours read apart without colour.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Text fields and search fields: a step DOWN from surface, so an input reads as a hole you type into.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Solid fallback for every glass surface when Reduce Transparency is on; also menus and popovers on Mac when they must be opaque.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims content behind a sheet or modal. Never used on its own as a colour.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of Liquid Glass chrome drawn by us (the custom tab bar, floating icon buttons, the Mac toolbar pill) under a 24 px blur with 150 % saturation. System-drawn glass is left to the system. Never behind body text over imagery without a scrim.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Separators between rows and between stats; the edge of a card on its ground. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: phone-rule
tokens.usage: A line between rows on the iPhone (Cockpit.Color.rule there): a step brighter than `hairline`, so a list has its rhythm, about 20 above its ground. The Mac and the sign-in page draw `hairline`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Visible edges where two surfaces of similar tone meet: a card on canvas in light, a popover edge, a table frame.

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: The boundary of a control that has no fill difference to rely on: toggle-off rim, an empty checkbox, a text field that sits directly on surface. At least 3:1 on canvas, surface and well.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on canvas, surface, raised, well and overlay: titles, row titles, figures. Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines under a title ("Juniper Kitchen · 50 m"), unselected tab labels, the person's words in serif. On every ground.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps on the line, gap lengths, mono section labels, placeholder text, units next to figures. On every ground; never for anything a person must read to act.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Labels of disabled controls only. Exempt from contrast by WCAG and deliberately quiet; never for live content.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `text`-coloured fill: the primary button label, the date on a `text` disc.

tokens.name: life
tokens.usage: THE LIFE. The stream line, capsules for anything with a duration, moment rings, the October river. Near-white in dark, ink in light: what happened is never coloured.

tokens.name: life-glyph
tokens.usage: The glyph drawn inside a `life` capsule (fork, laptop, moon). At least 3:1 on `life`.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Second step of a neutral data series: the second app bar in "on screen", a lighter stack segment. Never a hue.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Third step of a neutral data series. Still at least 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Fourth, faintest step: background bars and comparisons that need not be read on their own.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The empty track behind a bar or meter.

tokens.name: storage-1
tokens.usage: Settings > Storage's first hue: the largest stream, in the bar, its key, the growth chart and its row. A rank, never a stream's own colour: a stream that moves to another rank takes that rank's hue. At least 3:1 on surface in every theme; the four themes pass the dataviz palette checks (lightness band, chroma, colour-blind and normal separation).

tokens.name: storage-2
tokens.usage: Storage's second hue: the second largest stream. A rank, never a stream's own colour: a stream that moves to another rank takes that rank's hue. At least 3:1 on surface in every theme; the four themes pass the dataviz palette checks (lightness band, chroma, colour-blind and normal separation).

tokens.name: storage-3
tokens.usage: Storage's third hue: the third largest stream. A rank, never a stream's own colour: a stream that moves to another rank takes that rank's hue. At least 3:1 on surface in every theme; the four themes pass the dataviz palette checks (lightness band, chroma, colour-blind and normal separation).

tokens.name: storage-4
tokens.usage: Storage's fourth hue: the fourth largest stream. A rank, never a stream's own colour: a stream that moves to another rank takes that rank's hue. At least 3:1 on surface in every theme; the four themes pass the dataviz palette checks (lightness band, chroma, colour-blind and normal separation).

tokens.name: storage-5
tokens.usage: Storage's fifth hue: the fifth largest stream. A rank, never a stream's own colour: a stream that moves to another rank takes that rank's hue. At least 3:1 on surface in every theme; the four themes pass the dataviz palette checks (lightness band, chroma, colour-blind and normal separation).

tokens.name: storage-other
tokens.usage: Storage's Other streams: every stream past the fifth, as one part of the bar and one grey row each. The third data step, so it reads at 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: storage-own
tokens.usage: Storage's Index and AI: the home's own bytes (search, summaries, model answers), a grey between Other streams and the disk's.

tokens.name: storage-disk
tokens.usage: Storage's disk part, never the home's: solid while the first count runs, as Not yet counted; hatched once it is the other files on the disk (3 px lines, 3 px apart, at 135°). The faintest grey, a step off track.

tokens.name: plan
tokens.usage: THE PLAN, NOT YET. Calendar items still ahead, the dotted line after now, anything the person intends but has not happened. Dashed or dotted shapes only, never a solid fill. As text, on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: now
tokens.usage: NOW. The now disc on the line, the current time label, today's marker in a month. Exactly one now per view. As text, on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: engaged
tokens.usage: ENGAGED. A recorder that is running, a source that is live, a switch that is on. Always a filled disc or a switch, with a word ("Recording", "Live").

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: NEEDS YOU. Something the person must do for the record to stay whole ("Photos access is limited"). Always with a triangle and a sentence, and an action.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: STOPPED. A recorder that has stopped, a source that is broken, a destructive action. Always with a circled exclamation mark and a sentence.

tokens.name: here
tokens.usage: Selection, focus and current location. Ink, the text colour: the window has no accent hue.

tokens.name: plan-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `plan` text or a planned item that needs a fill (a selected plan).

tokens.name: now-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `now` text: the today cell in a month, the selected day chip.

tokens.name: engaged-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `engaged` text: the "Recording" header pill.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `caution` text: the needs-you banner, the "Fix" button.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `warning` text: the stopped banner, a destructive confirmation.

tokens.name: here-soft
tokens.usage: The ground behind something you chose (a filter pill with a choice in it), with its label in `here`.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a SOLID signal fill (a filled `caution` button, a `warning` badge). Dark ink in dark themes, white in light themes.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: The lifted pill of the one chosen on a track (the iPhone note's format bar): lighter than its `raised` track in dark, white with `shadow-knob` in light. Text on it is `text`.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: The knob of a switch and the thumb of a slider: white in every theme, lifted by `shadow-knob`.

tokens.name: photo-scrim
tokens.usage: What is drawn over a photo darkens it with black at half, in every theme, since a picture is the same picture in both: under a round tick or a face's ✕ (a `knob` ring), and Move and scale's picture outside its circle.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a one pixel line in a soft tint of the selection accent, over a `hover` wash on what is focused. Whole under Increase Contrast.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Fill of a selected row, sidebar item or calendar cell.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Pointer hover on Mac rows and plain buttons. iPhone has no hover.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state overlay for rows and plain buttons, on both platforms.

tokens.name: nest
tokens.usage: The ground of an open stay and of an open hour on Days: `text` at 3 % (6 % under Increase Contrast), so an hour open inside an open stay deepens by itself. Never a row's state: hover, pressed and selection fill over it.

tokens.name: code
tokens.usage: The dark modules of a code a camera scans (a QR code), the same in every appearance: a camera reads dark on light.

tokens.name: code-ground
tokens.usage: The tile under a code a camera scans, with its quiet zone: light in every appearance, held a breath below white in dark so it does not glare.

tokens.name: accent-solid
tokens.usage: The filled primary action; always paired with accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on the filled primary action.

map.note: The base map under the person's layer: its own quiet steps, which no other surface uses, so the map reads as one ground with the card floating over it and never competes with the person's places. Two appearances; Increase Contrast keeps its appearance's base map, and the person's layer on top takes that theme's colour tokens. The web kit's map style (`dashboard/public/ui/kit/map-style.json`) and cockpit.css (`--map-*`) are written from these, and the Swift package's `Cockpit.Color.map*`; the iPhone's MapKit draws the same discs, rings and halo over its muted map, brought to `map-land`.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Land: the map's ground, the frame before a map draws, and the halo behind every name on it.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Sea, lakes and rivers: a deep blue-grey, below the land in dark and above it in light, never a blue.

tokens.name: map-green
tokens.usage: Parks, woods, gardens and pitches: a breath of green in the land's grey.

tokens.name: map-building
tokens.usage: Buildings, from street zoom: one step above the land.

tokens.name: map-path
tokens.usage: Footpaths and tracks, from street zoom.

tokens.name: map-road-minor
tokens.usage: Streets and service roads: thin, no casing.

tokens.name: map-road-major
tokens.usage: Primary, secondary and tertiary roads and trunks: wider than a street, the same grey family.

tokens.name: map-road-motorway
tokens.usage: Motorways: the lightest road in dark, the widest in light.

tokens.name: map-boundary
tokens.usage: A country's border, dashed, at world and country zoom.

tokens.name: map-name-street
tokens.usage: A street's name along it, from street zoom.

tokens.name: map-name-park
tokens.usage: A park's name.

tokens.name: map-name-area
tokens.usage: A neighbourhood's or a country's name, in small capitals, letter-spaced.

tokens.name: map-name-water
tokens.usage: A sea's or a lake's name, in italics.

tokens.name: map-dim
tokens.usage: The iPhone only (MapGround.dim): how far Apple's muted land, once grey and veiled, sits above `map-land`, a multiply PlacesMap lays over it that brings it there, and its roads and names down by the same step (Apple's land measured on iOS 26 at 0x27 in dark, 0xF5 in light, brought to 0x1F and 0xF0).

families.sans: -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
families.serif: ui-serif, "New York", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif

groups.name: iOS · Text
groups.note: iPhone. Each style maps to an Apple text style so Dynamic Type scales it; sizes are the Large (default) setting.

styles.name: ios-display
styles.usage: Screen titles in the large-title position: Today, October, Mira. One per screen. (Apple: Large Title, at 600.)

styles.name: ios-title-1
styles.usage: Detail-screen titles that are not large titles: a day, a place. (Title 1, at 600.)

styles.name: ios-title-2
styles.usage: A selected item's title in a sheet; a card's hero line. (Title 2, at 500.)

styles.name: ios-greeting
styles.sample: What shall we look back on?
styles.usage: The one line over a blank Chat page, centred, at regular weight so it reads as an invitation, not a title. (Title 2, at 400.)

styles.name: ios-headline
styles.usage: Banner titles, button labels (lg, md), list section titles that are not mono labels. (Headline.)

styles.name: ios-body
styles.sample: Lifestream notes where you are through the day, so each day has places.
styles.usage: Running text: onboarding copy, explanations, settings descriptions. (Body.)

styles.name: ios-reading
styles.sample: You had dinner at Synthetic Cafe with Person A on Friday.
styles.usage: Words read at length: an answer of Ask, its questions and what is typed in its composer (Body, with the room a long read needs between lines).

styles.name: ios-row-title
styles.usage: The title of a row on the stream line and in lists. (Subheadline, at 500.)

styles.name: ios-subhead
styles.usage: The meta line under a row title; small-button labels. (Subheadline.)

styles.name: ios-footnote
styles.usage: Status lines, helper text under controls, card footers. (Footnote.)

styles.name: ios-caption
styles.usage: Labels under figures, chart axis labels. (Caption 1.)

styles.name: ios-label
styles.usage: Tags, chips and small badges: a word that names a state or a source.

styles.name: ios-caption-2
styles.usage: Tab-bar labels and the smallest legible label. The floor: nothing in the app is smaller than 11 pt. (Caption 2, medium.)

groups.name: iOS · Figures
groups.note: Numbers that are the point. Always tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; .monospacedDigit() in SwiftUI).

styles.name: ios-figure-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number on a screen.

styles.name: ios-figure-l
styles.usage: Stats in a grid (sleep, steps, people).

styles.name: ios-figure-m
styles.usage: Inline stats in a row of four (steps, messages, photos, music).

groups.name: iOS · Mono
groups.note: The instrument voice: what the machine measured. Times, gaps, durations in tables, section labels.

styles.name: ios-mono-label
styles.usage: Section labels. Always uppercase, `text-tertiary`. Never a sentence.

groups.name: iOS · Voice
groups.note: The person's own words, never the machine's.

styles.name: ios-voice
styles.usage: Anything the person said or wrote: a voice-note title, a check-in note, a note excerpt. Italic, in curly quotes, `text-secondary`.

styles.name: ios-voice-l
styles.usage: The person's words as the subject of a card (the day's check-in).

groups.name: macOS · Text
groups.note: The Mac window and menu bar. Same roles as iOS at Mac sizes; 11 px is the floor here too (one step above macOS's 10).

styles.name: mac-display
styles.usage: The window's view title. One per window.

styles.name: mac-greeting
styles.sample: What shall we look back on?
styles.usage: The one line over a blank Chat page, centred on the composer, at regular weight so it reads as an invitation, not a title.

styles.name: mac-title-1
styles.usage: Person and place headers.

styles.name: mac-heading
styles.usage: A thing's title inside a page: a stay's name on Days, a settings page's title, the inspector's title.

styles.name: mac-title-2
styles.usage: A dialog's title, popover titles.

styles.name: mac-headline
styles.usage: Row titles on the stream, list titles, button labels.

styles.name: mac-body
styles.sample: Bars are shares of the 2 h 50 m here.
styles.usage: Running text and meta lines.

styles.name: mac-reading
styles.sample: You had dinner at Synthetic Cafe with Person A on Friday.
styles.usage: Words read at length: an answer of Ask, its questions and what is typed in its composer.

styles.name: mac-subhead
styles.usage: Secondary meta, sidebar day summaries.

styles.name: mac-label
styles.usage: Tags and chips on the Mac.

styles.name: mac-footnote
styles.usage: Footers, captions under figures, the smallest Mac text.

styles.name: mac-figure-l
styles.usage: The day header's stat strip.

styles.name: mac-figure-m
styles.usage: Inline figures in the inspector.

styles.name: mac-mono-time
styles.usage: Hour rules and clock times on the Mac stream.

styles.name: mac-mono-label
styles.usage: Sentence case section labels and counts.

styles.name: mac-mono-data
styles.usage: Durations, values in tables and meters, keyboard hints.

styles.name: mac-voice
styles.usage: The person's own words on the Mac. Italic, curly quotes.

styles.name: mac-voice-l
styles.usage: The person's words as a card's subject in the inspector.

spacing.note: A 4 px grid, and space-px, the one hairline under it. iPhone margins are space-4 (16); the Mac window gutter is space-6 (24). Groups are separated by space-6, sections by space-8.

tokens.name: space-px
tokens.usage: The hairline between the stacked lines of one item (a row's name over its line), and between rows whose grounds would touch.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its badge; between stacked meta lines; dot to its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a button or row; between chips; inset of a concentric inner shape.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a row title and the trailing value; padding inside small controls and tags.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: iPhone screen margin; card padding; between rows of stats.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on large cards (onboarding, the check-in card); Mac inspector padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a screen; the Mac window gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections; above a large title.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Above and below an empty state.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top inset of onboarding art; the gap before a page footer.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing in onboarding and the Mac first run.

radius.note: Eight pixel controls, twelve pixel grouped surfaces, round avatars and geographic markers.

tokens.name: radius-2xs
tokens.usage: Chart bars and cells; the meter's track and fill.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Icon tiles on both platforms; links' and toggles' small shapes; swatches.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls and menus.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Mac list rows and the selected sidebar item inside a 16 px container (16 − 8); iPhone fields and inner shapes: photo thumbnails, viewers, wells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The ground of an open stay on Days: concentric with the rows' `radius-sm` inside it at 4 (12 − 4 = 8).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Grouped lists, cards and floating panels.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat's question bubble on both platforms, and a voice note's: round, softer than a card, its one line a capsule.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: iPhone sheets' content panels and the onboarding illustration panel.

tokens.name: radius-picture
tokens.usage: A picture sent with a question of Ask, standing over its bubble.

tokens.name: radius-composer
tokens.usage: The iPhone's composer, one card in every state (empty, typing, long, recording): concentric with its 36 circles 8 inside it (26 − 8 = 18).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: What is round by meaning: the switch, signal discs and rings, the now ring, monograms, the needs tile's disc, the life capsule (a duration's shape), and glass chrome. Controls are capsules too, through `radius-control`.

shadow.note: Dark mode separates by tone and a hairline, not by shadow; light mode adds soft shadow. No coloured glows.

tokens.name: shadow-edge
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped sections on canvas: a 1 px edge so a card holds its shape.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: A floating panel over a page or its map, the kit's one floating panel (`ck-float`, `ck-panel`, at radius-lg): the moment's panel, Places' card, Organise's and Edit's panel, the naming deck's card. Never a card inside a column, which takes the hairline outline, so a page's head and its ground stay one.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A dialog over the scrim: close, not a wide glow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the menu bar popover, a dragged item.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass surface we draw: the lip, the rim and the float, together. Pair with `glass`.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: The switch knob and the light-theme thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Sheets, the Mac window itself in mockups, onboarding panels.

size.note: Fixed dimensions. iPhone hit targets are never under 44 pt; Mac controls are 28 px with a 32 px row.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on iPhone. A smaller visible control extends its hit area to this.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: iPhone primary call to action (full-width onboarding button).

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: iPhone default button, icon button, search field.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: iPhone inline button inside a banner or row (hit area still 44).

tokens.name: size-control-mac
tokens.usage: Mac controls: buttons, icon buttons, the search field, filter pills, view pills, menu buttons. Inside it, a 20 px key hint or a 26 px clear sits concentric.

tokens.name: size-action-mac
tokens.usage: The action control's one width on the Mac: its widest result, the check disc and Connected, inside its padding. Every verb and result it says fits; a longer label is a sign the word should be shorter.

tokens.name: size-onboarding-column
tokens.usage: The onboarding's one column: the mark, every step's head, body and fixed foot run centred on it, so the window's margins are equal and Back and Continue sit on its edges on every step.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Minimum iPhone list and stream row.

tokens.name: size-row-mac
tokens.usage: A Mac list or table row of one line (principle 25).

tokens.name: size-row-mac-tall
tokens.usage: A two-line Mac row: a stream's name over today's amount, its icon in a 36 px slot (principle 25).

tokens.name: size-row-nav-mac
tokens.usage: A nav row (principle 25): the sidebar's rows, Search's row, your own row, Settings' list of pages.

tokens.name: size-lead
tokens.usage: The lead column of an iPhone row among faces: a face, or an icon centred in the faces' column (principle 25).

tokens.name: size-form-label
tokens.usage: A form's label column where the labels are a fixed short set (Contacts' edit sheet), on both platforms (principle 29).

tokens.name: size-icon-xs
tokens.usage: Glyphs inside a 24 px moment ring; inline status glyphs.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Mac sidebar and toolbar icons; icons inside small buttons; glyphs in a 28 px capsule.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: iPhone list-row and button icons; Mac inspector icons.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: iPhone tab bar, toolbar and icon-button glyphs.

tokens.name: size-icon-xl
tokens.usage: Onboarding and empty-state glyphs.

tokens.name: size-capsule
tokens.usage: Width of a life capsule on iPhone; 22 px on Mac (size-capsule-mac).

tokens.name: size-capsule-mac
tokens.usage: Width of a life capsule on the Mac stream.

tokens.name: size-moment
tokens.usage: Diameter of a moment ring (voice note, check-in, photo).

tokens.name: size-loading
tokens.usage: The loading mark where a page or a section is read; inside a card or a row it is size-icon-sm (16).

tokens.name: size-reading
tokens.usage: The measure of Ask on the Mac: the thread, its pictures and the composer are at most this wide.

tokens.name: size-main
tokens.usage: The day's list on Days, beside its map: at most this wide, centred in the room the map leaves.

tokens.name: size-frame
tokens.usage: A Mac page's frame (PageFrame): title, top controls, tabs, body and any right column at most this wide together, centred in the pane, so a wide display leaves even space on both sides and the top controls end on the content's right edge.

tokens.name: size-onboarding-width
tokens.usage: The onboarding's one window, from Move to Applications to the last step: its width. The main window opens at it while the onboarding shows, and grows to its own size once it ends.

tokens.name: size-onboarding-height
tokens.usage: The onboarding's one window: its height, the tallest step (Record, every grant allowed) with no scroll.

tokens.name: size-composer
tokens.usage: The composer at one line, on both platforms: the 32 send circle 6 inside it, its corner radius-2xl, so the two run parallel.

tokens.name: size-composer-control
tokens.usage: The iPhone composer's controls: the send circle, the stop circle, + and the mic in its tool row, and the pick chip's height.

tokens.name: size-thumb
tokens.usage: A picture picked for a question, waiting in the iPhone's composer over its words.

tokens.name: size-question-picture
tokens.usage: The width of a picture sent with a question on the iPhone, at 4:3, over its bubble.

tokens.name: size-voice-note
tokens.usage: The width of a voice note sent as a question on the iPhone: its player over its words.

tokens.name: size-drawer
tokens.usage: The conversations drawer from the leading edge: on the iPhone the page moves this far aside, its edge still seen; on the Mac the width of the conversations panel under Chat's clock.

tokens.name: size-citation
tokens.usage: A citation capsule in an answer: its number, on raised, inside a line of reading text.

tokens.name: size-code
tokens.usage: The side of a code a camera scans (a QR code with its quiet zone) on the Mac, read from an arm's length.

tokens.name: size-avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Monogram beside a name in a Mac row.

tokens.name: size-avatar-chip
tokens.usage: A face in a person's chip at the foot of the iPhone's photo viewer.

tokens.name: size-avatar-md
tokens.usage: Monogram on a Go to tile in Search.

tokens.name: size-avatar-row
tokens.usage: A face leading a row of a page (a person), in the row's 36 slot.

tokens.name: size-avatar-portrait
tokens.usage: A face over its name among the people in the iPhone photo viewer's Info.

tokens.name: size-portrait-name
tokens.usage: The widest a person's column stands among the people in the iPhone photo viewer's Info: as wide as the name from the face's size-avatar-portrait, the name cut with an ellipsis past it.

tokens.name: size-avatar-tile
tokens.usage: A face in a strip of tiles (This month's people).

tokens.name: size-avatar-head
tokens.usage: A face on the head of a person's page.

stroke.note: Line weights. Phosphor Regular draws at 1.5 px on a 24 px icon; our strokes are 2 px so the stream sits slightly heavier than the icons around it.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Glass rims and Retina hairlines (renders as one device pixel on 2x and 3x).

tokens.name: stroke-border
tokens.usage: Separators, card edges, control boundaries.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: The stream line, moment rings, the now ring, dashed plan outlines.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, drawn in `focus` with stroke-focus-offset of space between.

tokens.name: stroke-focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus ring.

tokens.name: dash-plan
tokens.usage: Dash pattern of a planned capsule outline (on, off), in `plan`.

tokens.name: dash-future
tokens.usage: Dot pattern of the line after now, in `plan`.

opacity.note: Used sparingly; prefer a colour token.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Icons and fills of disabled controls (their labels use text-disabled).

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: A filled button while pressed (with a 0.97 scale): the press reads as the button giving way.

tokens.name: opacity-past-plan
tokens.usage: A plan whose time has passed without a record: it fades, it does not disappear.

duration.note: Motion is information: it shows where something came from. Every animation has a Reduce Motion version (a crossfade at duration-fast, or nothing).

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Pressed states, toggles snapping, hover.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Crossfades; the Reduce Motion replacement for every movement.

tokens.name: duration-fold
tokens.usage: A stay or an hour folding on Days, with `ease-in-out`: its height shrinks and its rows fade, all at once.

tokens.name: duration-open
tokens.usage: A stay or an hour opening in place on Days, with `ease-out`: the rows' wrapper grows from the head while the rows rise 4 px into place, half a `duration-stagger` apart, the first eight only.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Sheets and popovers appearing, a row expanding.

tokens.name: duration-settle
tokens.usage: The web's one duration: how long a panel, a dialog or a fold moves after a press. `kit.css` sets `duration-open` and `duration-base` to it on the web, and `duration-fast` and `duration-fold` to two thirds of it; native code keeps its own.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Screen-level transitions we own (not the system's push).

tokens.name: duration-draw
tokens.usage: How long a row reached from a name or a person holds its `selection` fill on Days before it lets go over `duration-fast`.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between things that arrive one after another: what a grant settles in the onboarding, a row at a time; on Days, half of it between the rows of a stay opening.

tokens.name: duration-breath
tokens.usage: One cycle of the now ring's breath, the engaged dot's pulse and the loading mark's sway. Static under Reduce Motion, where the loading mark breathes at it instead. design/marks/logo.py writes it into the dashboard's loader.svg: run it after changing this.

tokens.name: duration-grace
tokens.usage: How long a read may take before the loading mark shows: a quicker answer shows none at all.

tokens.name: duration-patience
tokens.usage: How long a read may wait before the page-size loading mark says "Waiting for Lifestream." under it: waiting is not failing.

tokens.name: duration-dwell
tokens.usage: Chat's work line: the least time a phrase stays before the next rolls in, so steps quicker than it never flash.

tokens.name: duration-quiet
tokens.usage: Chat's work line: how long it waits with no step open before it says "Thinking"; and the answer's catch-up: the words waiting show within it of the last that arrived.

tokens.name: duration-decrypt
tokens.usage: Chat's privacy view: how long one hidden detail takes to decrypt between the person's words and the placeholder the model read; its box glides to the new width over `duration-base` and its letters lock in from the left.

tokens.name: duration-decrypt-stagger
tokens.usage: Chat's privacy view: the delay between one hidden detail's decrypt and the next, in reading order.

tokens.name: duration-sweep
tokens.usage: One pass of the light across Chat's shimmering work line. Still under Reduce Motion.

tokens.name: duration-word
tokens.usage: Chat's answer: one character's turn at the slowest even pace (about 70 a second, a dozen words); the pace quickens when the characters waiting grow, so it never falls behind the model.

easing.note: Two curves and one spring. SwiftUI: .spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.85) is ease-spring.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that arrives: sheets, popovers, the line drawing, capsules swelling.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things that move from one place to another on screen (the selection pill sliding between tabs).

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: The web stand-in for the spring: folds opening, a toggle knob. Native code uses the real spring.

health.note: The home's nine states of a connector, a copy, a device or a need, in precedence, each with the one shape every screen draws before the home's own words, and the one word a list row's end draws for it (null: the row shows its time instead); a screen writes no other word for a state. tools/design.ts writes this table for the apps (Cockpit's HealthState, its signal and word) and for the web kit (health-states.json).

states.name: setup
states.usage: Not set up: no shape; its catalogue row says what connecting takes.

states.name: paused
states.usage: A pause stands: the idle ring.

states.name: needs-you
states.usage: The person must act: the caution triangle.

states.name: broken
states.usage: Failing past its window, or a delivery that will not import: the circled mark.

states.name: waiting
states.usage: Waiting on something that ends by itself: the idle ring.

states.name: quiet
states.usage: Nothing new, or its device silent: the idle ring.

states.name: syncing
states.usage: Its history still arriving: no shape; its line says it.

states.name: ok
states.usage: Reading: no shape; its line says it.

onboarding.note: The onboarding's own layer: the website's river, Geist and the night palette, apart from Cockpit's pages. It is night whatever the system's appearance; `night-hc` is Increase Contrast (stronger text, stronger lines, an opaque glass), and a token without it keeps its night value there. What the onboarding draws from Cockpit sits in `.ck-night`, which sets Cockpit's own tokens to their dark values.

font.usage: Every word of the onboarding, before the system's sans (`type.families.sans`): Geist, the website's face (OFL), from `design/river/geist.woff2`, which the dashboard and the Mac app's bundled page serve at this path.

color.name: ob-ground
color.usage: The night under everything: the window's ground, the photograph's shade, the primary button's words.

color.name: ob-ink
color.usage: What is said: titles, a row's name, a done step in the ledger, the primary button's fill.

color.name: ob-soft
color.usage: What explains: the lede, a row's line, what a done step brought in, a done control's word.

color.name: ob-faint
color.usage: What waits: a step ahead in the ledger, the quietest note. Words still: at least 4.5:1 on the ground and on a panel.

color.name: ob-line
color.usage: An edge you press: the secondary button's hairline, a field's and a copy button's edge.

color.name: ob-hairline
color.usage: Between the rows of a panel, the panel's own edge, the foot's top edge while the body runs under it.

color.name: ob-panel
color.usage: The one quiet panel every list's rows sit on.

color.name: ob-raised
color.usage: A fill a step above the panel: a chip, a meter's track, a numbered step's disc.

color.name: ob-glacier
color.usage: Where you are: the ledger's open step (its bar and its label), Go back, the done control's check, the story art's marks.

color.name: ob-glacier-soft
color.usage: Where you are, quiet: a tag, the glow of a ledger row turning done, a folder dragged over Where to keep it.

color.name: ob-live
color.usage: Recording now: the pulse on You're set.

color.name: ob-glass
color.usage: Glass over the photograph, under a 10 to 14 blur: the story screens' chips and cards, You're set's panel. Pair with `ob-shadow-glass`.

shadow.name: ob-shadow-glass
shadow.usage: The glass's edge: one hairline inside its shape.

type.name: ob-display
type.sample: Lifestream, the open source home for your personal context.
type.usage: A story screen's title, two-tone: its first sentence in `ob-ink`, its second in `ob-soft`, at one size.

type.name: ob-story-lede
type.sample: It gathers what your Mac, your iPhone and the apps you use know about you into one stream, keeps it on this Mac, and lets you ask it anything.
type.usage: The words under a story screen's title.

type.name: ob-title
type.usage: A step's title, at the top of the column.

type.name: ob-lede
type.sample: Your library is years of where you've been and who was with you.
type.usage: The line under a step's title, in `ob-soft`.

type.name: ob-row-name
type.usage: A row's name on a panel.

type.name: ob-row-line
type.sample: What’s on your screen, as video and text, so you can find anything you saw.
type.usage: The line under a row's name, in `ob-soft`; a refusal stands in its place.

type.name: ob-small
type.sample: What you ask, and what it needs from your life, goes to the model you choose.
type.usage: Small words under a panel and in the foot: the lock line, the pairing's turn, a done control's word.

type.name: ob-ledger-name
type.usage: A step's label in Your stream; the open step's at 500.

type.name: ob-ledger-line
type.usage: What a done step brought in, under its label in Your stream.

type.name: ob-label
type.usage: A head over a list, uppercase: Your stream.

type.name: ob-button
type.usage: A button's words; the action control's too.
